rows.evidence: The MLJ Trust's own Sermon on the Mount article says the 1950–51 series was never recorded because recording only began in 1953, and no free public-domain or authorised reading of the book turned up (it is still in copyright).

The MLJ Trust Spiritual Depression topic page lists the series sermons, including 'General Considerations on Spiritual Depression' and 'That One Sin', each with a Play Sermon button and a free MP3 download.

The MLJ Trust Book of Ephesians page describes 232 sermons preached 1954–1962 and lists sermons such as 'The Mystery of God' (Eph 1:1) and 'Chosen in Him' (Eph 1:4), each with play and free MP3 download.

The MLJ Trust Book of Romans page describes 366 sermons from 1955–1968 and lists sermons such as 'A Man Called Paul' (Rom 1:1) and 'Not Ashamed of the Gospel' (Rom 1:16-17), each with play and free MP3 download.

The MLJ Trust Revival page introduces 'his landmark sermons on revival from 1959, marking the 100th anniversary of the Welsh Revival of 1859' and lists sermons such as 'Diagnosing the Need', each with play and free download.

rows.listen_label: MLJ Trust recording (first sermon of the series)
rows.evidence: The MLJ Trust page for sermon #5583 'The Means of Salvation' on Galatians 6:14, originally preached 20 October 1963 (the first of the ten Cross sermons), has a player and an MP3 download. The Trust has no single page for the whole series.

The MLJ Trust Preaching and Preachers page lists all 16 of the 1969 Westminster Theological Seminary lectures, from 'Primacy of Preaching' to 'The Spirit and The Power', plus two Q&A sessions, each with free MP3 download and playback.
The MLJ Trust page shows sermon #4165 'True Love' on Ephesians 5:25-33, dated 14 February 1960, with a player and an MP3 download.
The MLJ Trust page shows sermon #3344 'Love Your Neighbour' on Romans 13:8-10, originally preached 3 March 1967, with a player and an MP3 download.
The MLJ Trust page shows sermon #5378 'Because He First Loved Us' on Luke 7:36-50, originally preached 19 September 1954, with a player and a download.
The MLJ Trust page shows sermon #3331 'Overcoming Evil' on Romans 12:20-21, originally preached 11 November 1966, with a player and the MP3 3331-overcoming-evil.mp3.
The MLJ Trust page shows sermon #4054 'He is Our Peace' on Ephesians 2:14-16, dated 19 February 1956, with a player and a download.
The MLJ Trust page shows sermon #2007 'The Fellowship of Believers' on Acts 2:41-47, originally preached 21 February 1965, with a play button and an MP3 download.

No legitimate free recording of the 18 October 1966 'Evangelical Unity: An Appeal' address was found. The MLJ Trust's undated 'Evangelical Unity' (#5714) never mentions the Assembly, 1966 or Stott, and a 2017 Flinders thesis citing the Trust places that address at the 1957 Evangelical Alliance Annual Meeting.
